items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the Euler sequence on projective space, exhibiting $\Omega$ as the kernel of a surjection from a direct sum of twisted structure sheaves onto $\mathcal{O}$ (statement lines 1593-1599). The proof fixes the Proj presentation and writes both maps explicitly on each standard open, with the coefficients justified by the standard descriptions of the invertible sheaves involved; the verification of exactness is a routine check the author leaves to the reader. Spelling out the two maps is the substance, so the claim is H2.
